outcome: Induced labor rate due to fetal malformation
cohort: 412 patients who underwent single vitrified blastocyst transfer between January 2018 and June 2020
finding: Different vitrification systems might differentially affect birth outcomes, specifically preterm delivery rate and cesarean delivery rate.
mod_finding: The cesarean delivery rate was significantly higher in the group that used vitrification kit B compared to kit A (70.25% vs. 57.26%, P < 0.05).
birth_weight: Neonatal body weight was measured but no specific values were reported
